name: evalexpr_rhai
description: Evaluate Rhai scripts against row values in DuckDB SQL. Pass a context object into a script and inspect either its JSON result or its error.

cta.title: Rhai scripting in SQL
cta.description: Install evalexpr_rhai to evaluate Rhai expressions and full scripts from inside SQL — column-driven branching, custom math, dynamic rules pulled from the database, all in a sandboxed interpreter.

quickStart.title: Apply a rule to each row
quickStart.description: The script reads the salary from its context. The .ok field contains the successful result.
quickStart.sql:
WITH employees(name, salary) AS (
  VALUES ('Mina', 95000), ('Theo', 120000)
)
SELECT name,
       evalexpr_rhai('context.salary > 100000', {'salary': salary}).ok AS high_earner
FROM employees
ORDER BY name;
quickStart.note: The return value is a union of `ok` and `error`. Check the error arm when scripts or inputs may be invalid.

introduction.title: Evaluate rules written in a small scripting language
paragraphs: Rhai is an embedded scripting language with variables, conditions, loops, and functions. This extension evaluates a Rhai expression from SQL and lets you pass row values into the script as JSON context.

Use it for configurable scoring rules or transformations that are awkward to express as SQL. The script can live in a literal or a column. Each evaluation returns either a JSON result or an error value, so you can inspect failed rows alongside successful ones.
